dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Will I ever be able to sail to the world's end?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your next route...

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: My first mate and I haven't really made plans just yet, but I do hope that we'll make it a little further.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Each time I return to land and look back upon the route that we just took in this manner, I can't help but sigh...

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Even the longest of sea routes is still all too short when seen from on high.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Perhaps one cannot traverse every river and every ocean in a single lifetime.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: But since I've chosen this path... You never know what you'll encounter unless you try, right? Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about the "prophecy"?

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Although there have been instances of rising water levels in our history, I'm inclined to focus on my current life and what I'll do before the prophecy comes to pass.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: I mean, everyone must return to their home and set their feet on solid ground one day, after having departed on countless voyages.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: As for distant dangers like prophecies, I think it's best left to long-lived beings such as deities.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: See you, friend. Sail safe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the prophecy...

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: About that... I heard that when the prophecy occurred, the chaos was worst around the opera house. Romaritime Harbor was too far away, and all sorts of rumors were flying around.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Some people said that the Hydro Archon did all she could to prevent the ultimate disaster, while others said it was Monsieur Neuvillette who resolved it...

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Well, seeing as Lady Furina has, indeed, left her post, I'm leaning more towards... the former statement?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Like the constant adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Yes, my friend, precisely.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Navigating to the end of the world is my goal, and the process of achieving it is just as important.

dialogues.speaker: Galathee
dialogues.text: Though I am not an adventurer, my adventuring experiences are just as thrilling as theirs.
